en.p: In the coordinate plane there is a triangle $\mathrm{ABC}$ with $\overline{\mathrm{AB}}=\overline{\mathrm{AC}}=8\sqrt{5}$ and $\overline{\mathrm{BC}}=16$. A point $\mathrm{P}$ on segment $\mathrm{AB}$, a point $\mathrm{Q}$ on segment $\mathrm{BC}$, and a point $\mathrm{R}$ on segment $\mathrm{CA}$ satisfy the following conditions.

For points $\mathrm{X}$ satisfying $\left|3\overrightarrow{\mathrm{XP}}+\overrightarrow{\mathrm{XR}}\right|=\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{PR}}\right|$, let $M$ and $m$ be the maximum and minimum values of $\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{BX}}\right|$, respectively. Find the value of $M\times m$. (Given that $\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{PQ}}\right|>0$.) [4 points]
